title: Sugarcane farmers block highway in Kolhapur over prices

tea.why: Sugarcane farmers are protesting to demand higher sugarcane purchase prices from sugar mills.
tea.want: Protesters want a rate of Rs 5,500 per tonne for sugarcane, uniform pricing across Maharashtra, and higher purchase prices.
tea.changed: Nov 4: The highway blockade at Kini Toll Naka entered its second day as protesters slept on the road overnight.

summary: Sugarcane farmers blocked the Pune-Bengaluru National Highway at Kini Toll Naka in Kolhapur district, Maharashtra. Led by former Member of Parliament Raju Shetti under the Swabhimani Shetkari Sanghatana, the protesters launched an indefinite road blockade to demand a sugarcane price of Rs 5,500 per tonne and uniform pricing across the state. Hundreds of farmers spent the night on the highway, causing traffic disruptions and leaving trucks stranded as police implemented diversions from Karad to Kagal. According to reports, no government minister or representative had approached the demonstrators to negotiate after more than 20 hours of protest. Meanwhile, Kolhapur district collector Vijay Rathod reportedly sought proposals from millers regarding installment payments, and a central team prepared to hold discussions with stakeholders in Pune.
response: Highway police implemented traffic diversions along the Karad to Kagal stretch and advised commuters to use alternative routes. Kolhapur district collector Vijay Rathod reportedly sought a proposal from millers regarding payment installments.

updates.text: Members of the Swabhimani Shetkari Sanghatana launched an indefinite road blockade at Kini Toll Naka.
The highway blockade entered its second morning with hundreds of farmers having slept on the road overnight.
